# Changelog

Plain-language history of the project, newest first. One dated entry per piece of work, written so a teammate who was away can catch up by reading it. A finished piece writes its entry to its own file in `changes/` first, and its merge folds that file in here under the day it reached `main`. /sync and /ship fold any file still waiting, such as one from a merge made on GitHub by hand.
